An '''unidentified male''' [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] served as a [[Combat engineer (Techno Union)|combat engineer]] in the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Near the end of the war, the Skakoan was among the Techno Union scientists who participated in the experiments performed on the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]] as part of a larger scheme by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] combat engineer was among the scientists who were assigned to the planet [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]] in order to oversee experiements on male members of the native [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]] which turned them into mutant [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] soldiers for Separatist commander [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who ordered the army to be delivered to him as soon as the last specimen was was transformed. 

Unbeknownst to the Techno Union officials, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] discovered and infiltrated the base of operations for the program, where he overheard the Skakoan combat engineer express his worries to the [[Techno Union scientist|head scientist]] that the specimens were not ready, but the head scientist dismissed this.<ref name="CWc24" /> As the engineers began to transform the final specimen, [[Harvos]], Skywalker revealed himself and saved Harvos. The head scientist released the other specimens and ordered them to attack Skywalker despite the combat engineer's objections. The combat engineer subsequently fled the facility as Skywalker freed the other mutants. However, before the combat engineer and the other scientists could get to their [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport|transport]], Skywalker arrived, having just destroyed the facility's [[siphon generator]], at the cost of his [[Mechno-arm/Legends|mechanical hand]]. Angered, Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to kill all of the scientists, including the combat engineer.<ref name="CWc253">{{CW|25}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Skakoan was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]].<ref name="CWc24" />
